name: The Fool
meaning_upright: New beginnings, optimism, trust in life
meaning_reversed: Recklessness, being taken advantage of, inconsideration
description: The Fool represents the start of a journey, stepping off a cliff into the unknown with pure faith.

name: The Magician
meaning_upright: Action, the power to manifest, resourcefulness
description: The Magician connects the spiritual and physical worlds, using tools to manifest their will.

name: The High Priestess
description: The High Priestess sits at the gate of the subconscious, urging you to listen to your inner voice.

name: The Empress
description: The Empress is the mother figure of the tarot, representing fertility and the abundance of nature.

name: The Emperor
meaning_reversed: Domination, excessive control, lack of discipline
description: The Emperor brings order to chaos, representing structure, rules, and masculine energy.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_reversed: Personal beliefs, freedom, challenging the status quo
description: The Hierophant represents tradition and established institutions, acting as a bridge to the divine.

name: The Lovers
meaning_reversed: Self-love, disharmony, imbalance, misalignment of values
description: The Lovers represent distinct choices and the union of dualities, usually in relationships.

name: The Chariot
meaning_reversed: Self-discipline issues, aggression, lack of direction
description: The Chariot represents overcoming conflict and moving forward through sheer willpower.

name: Strength
description: Strength reminds you that true power comes from inner calm and patience, not brute force.

name: The Hermit
description: The Hermit walks alone to find the light of truth, representing a time for self-reflection.

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning_upright: Good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny
meaning_reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles
description: The Wheel turns for everyone; it represents the inevitable cycles of fate and change.

name: Justice
meaning_upright: Justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect
description: Justice holds the scales of truth, reminding us that every action has a consequence.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: Pause, surrender, letting go, new perspectives
description: The Hanged Man suggests a suspension of action to gain a new perspective through sacrifice.

name: Death
description: Death is rarely physical; it represents the end of a cycle and the beginning of a new one.

name: Temperance
description: Temperance is the alchemist, blending opposites to find balance and harmony in life.

name: The Devil
meaning_reversed: Releasing limiting beliefs, exploring dark thoughts
description: The Devil represents the chains we forge for ourselves through addiction or materialism.

name: The Tower
description: The Tower brings destruction to false structures, clearing the way for truth.

name: The Star
description: The Star follows the Tower, bringing hope, renewal, and spiritual healing.

name: The Moon
meaning_reversed: Release of fear, repressed emotion, confusion
description: The Moon represents the realm of dreams and illusions where things are not always as they seem.

name: The Sun
meaning_reversed: Inner child, feeling down, overly optimistic
description: The Sun is the best card in the deck, radiating joy, success, and positivity.

name: Judgement
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, inner critic, ignoring the call
description: Judgement calls for a rising up, a moment of reckoning and awakening to a new life.

name: The World
description: The World represents the successful conclusion of a long journey and total fulfillment.

name: Ace of Cups
description: The Ace of Cups offers a cup flowing with love, emotion, and the potential for new relationships.

name: Two of Cups
description: The Two of Cups represents a union of souls, whether romantic, platonic, or business.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: Raw power, victory, break-throughs, mental clarity
description: The Ace of Swords represents a breakthrough moment of mental clarity and truth.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_reversed: An emerging idea, lack of direction, distractions
description: The Ace of Wands is the spark of creativity and the urge to take action on a new idea.

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A new financial or career opportunity, manifestation
meaning_reversed: Lost opportunity, lack of planning and foresight
description: The Ace of Pentacles represents a seed of prosperity planted in the material world.
